steps.name: Martelly's letter
steps.objective: Go to “Free Trade City of Rivera” and find [Martelli].

steps.name: kingdom of dwarves
steps.objective: After talking with [Martelli], go to [Alvis] on “Merrin Island.”

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's happening this time?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: It's not like anything big has happened yet... There's something I'd like to ask of you.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Do you know about a country called Aki City?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: It's a dwarven kingdom on Merin Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the Dwarven Kingdom… .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: There is a second prince there, a man named Juan, who is my friend.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: We've been dating for quite some time.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: We've been in touch regularly, but there's no news this time.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Recently, I heard that trouble occurred in Archicity due to the Magic Stone Laboratory incident... .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: There is no news from Prince Juan, and I am very anxious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay for me to go to Aki City and check the situation?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Originally, when we were exchanging letters, a brave dwarf girl named ‘Dorun’ came.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: What's really going on... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Road to Aki City
steps.objective: After talking to [Alvis], go to "Archi City", defeat [Acidic Lava Bubble] and [Killing Machine Boxer], and then go to [Dorun].

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Wow, it's been such a long time.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: What's going on here? Have you been hunting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it, I'm trying to go to Aki City but I don't know the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go to Archicity at Martelli's request.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Well, it would be dangerous, and that neighborhood seems to be pretty noisy these days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Noisy?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I fought several wars with synthetic life forms that escaped from the magic stone laboratory... .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: There must have been some problem in the process.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Archicity troops used to appear here often.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I turned on my eyes and searched the magic stone laboratory... .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: It would be better not to go. The atmosphere is scary, so I avoid that area too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Still, I think you have to come and experience the atmosphere for yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because that was Mr. Martelly’s request.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Archi City is located on the outskirts of Marin Island. Go straight across the island. You will see Archicity.

steps.name: Dorun the Brave
steps.objective: After talking to [Dorun], defeat [Archigolem Yellow] and [Blaster Cabot] in “Archicity”. And report to [Dorun].

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Huh, there’s a human here… ?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Well, who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to see Prince Juan at Mr. Martelly’s request… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … They said it was a dangerous place, but I guess I came here for no reason.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: If you are Martelly... This is the person I was trying to find.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Prince Hurin and his group would not be their subordinates since they would ignore humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, by any chance, what is your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Martelli said that Prince Juan's letter was delivered to him by a dwarf girl named 'Dorun'... .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I am Dorun.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Seeing as you know so accurately, it is clear... .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Um, but I have to make sure I verify my identity... .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Please prove that you really belong to Martelly, Prince Juan's friend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

steps.name: king of dwarves
steps.objective: After talking to [Dorun], defeat [Hurin] in the “Dwarf Airship” and obtain the [Prison Key]. Then come back and report to [Dorun].

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: You're here! I watched the action clearly with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: What a performance!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Now you can trust that you are not a spy for King Hurin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, what is the current situation in Archicity?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I being attacked by the same dwarf?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Actually… His Majesty passed away not long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Do you know that it is a magic stone laboratory?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: That place is a synthetic life laboratory created by Rivera's humans... .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: The monsters that came out from there attacked Archicity.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: His Majesty led the army to fight to protect the country, but then... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: The first prince, Hurin, ascended the throne determined to seek revenge.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: In the process, Prince Juan, who had tried to stop the attack on Rivera, was imprisoned.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Furin is overconfident in Akicity’s power.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: In the name of revenge, they are actually trying to wage a war of conquest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, is it okay for me to rescue Prince Juan?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Hurin holds the prison key.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: In the end, we must break through that heavily guarded army and defeat Hurin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It may seem like a bit of a difficult task, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, I'll try my best.

steps.name: prince locked in a cage
steps.objective: After talking with [Dorun], go to [Juan] inside the “Dwarf Airship”.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: You are truly amazing!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I heard that Furin's dedicated machine boasts the best performance... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, the gloves are sturdy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were quite a few interesting features… .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: The feeling of winning against that enormous battle machine is just... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you think about the enemies you will face in the future, that is nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, now that I have the key, I need to rescue Prince Juan.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Thank you for your support until the end!

steps.name: secure escape route
steps.objective: After talking with [Juan], report to [Dorun] in “Archicity”.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Obtaining the key means... Can I say that I defeated my brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can look at it that way.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: You are truly amazing.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I am truly indebted to Adventurer and Martelly.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: This Juan, I will never forget and repay you until I die!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Thanks to Adventurer, I think the conversation will become easier.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I plan to persuade my brother's followers to change direction.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Look at that Adventurer that defeated you!

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: That is the human potential you have looked down on!

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: After suffering such humiliation without being able to handle it properly... .

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: What kind of disaster are you bringing up about war to bring about?

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: We must be friendly with them.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: It's good to feel proud as a dwarf, but you must let go of your stubbornness.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: We have a lot to learn from humans.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I will act as a bridge.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Development should be pursued through diplomacy, not war.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: … Let me tell the story like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look great.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help you until the end.

steps.name: Back to Rivera
steps.objective: After talking with [Dorun], go to “Free Trade City Rivera” and find [Martelli].

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Thank you for rescuing the prince!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Now I have to go back to the prince!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still many enemies against us, so be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if anything happens, please tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I know this, I will help you as much as I can.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Ugh… !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Poe, a storm is starting to rage!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, where is it? Where is the storm... ?!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: In my heart... .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: A storm of emotions... sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, we will definitely provide you with service until the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll secure an escape route for you, so use the opportunity to get to Prince Juan.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: … Something like that happened.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: A simple request turned out to be bigger than I thought.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I'm sorry. I apologize.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't that difficult.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: A huge war almost broke out.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: But Prince Juan made a good decision.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: No matter how great your technology is... .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: The war with Rivera was a truly reckless decision.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: This is not our only city.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Even if I fight a war alone, I don't think I'll lose... .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: The new mayor and executives are all smart people.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: He must have asked his allies for help.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Prince Juan's judgment prevented the disaster that would descend on Aquicity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. okay.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Soon, there will be an interesting diplomatic battle.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I have a lot to prepare, so you can report to the mayor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, who is Rivera’s new mayor?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Don't you remember who led us?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh, obviously… .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Come on, let’s go. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Adventurer is here!

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: I was planning to contact you soon... Welcome!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … You have become mayor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: It's not just good.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: There's too much work... I'm wasting my time paying for documents.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: By the way, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Eva about Archicity.)

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: You have really done a great job.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Please leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you for saving Rivera from disaster again.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: How should I repay this favor? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pay it off slowly later, if you can afford it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you're probably busy, I'll just... .

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Take a look!

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you so much!
